newsitem.title: USA: TI Q3 shr minus charge falls to $0.23.
newsitem.headline: TI Q3 shr minus charge falls to $0.23.

text.p: (In millions of dollars, except per-share amounts.)
Income (loss) before provision for income taxes (133) 431

(A) Beginning in 1996, the company has made reclassifications to its statement of income to conform with current industry practices. Research and development expense, which was previously included in cost of revenues, is now presented separately. Also, employees' retirement and profit-sharing plans expense, previously separately reported, is now allocated throughout operating costs and expenses, consistent with other employee benefit costs. Prior year amounts have been reclassified to conform with the 1996 presentations.

(B) Net loss for the third quarter of 1996 includes the effect of a one-time $192 million charge for the value of acquired in-process R&D from the acquisition of Silicon Systems (SSi). There is no tax offset associated with the charge. Income for the third quarter was $44 million, or $0.23 per share, excluding this charge.

(C) Earnings (loss) per common and common equivalent share are based on average common and common equivalent shares outstanding (189.7 million shares and 195.1 million shares for the third quarters of 1996 and 1995).
Income before provision for income taxes 199 1189
(A) Same stipulations as in footnote (A) for the quarter.

(B) Net income for the nine months ended Sept. 30, 1996 includes the effect of a one-time, third quarter charge for the value of acquired in-process R&D from the SSi acquisition. There is no tax offset associated with the charge.
Income for the nine months was $283 million, or $1.46 per share, excluding this charge.

(C) Earnings per common and common equivalent share based on average common and common equivalent shares outstanding (191.8 million shares and 193.3 million shares for the nine months ended September 30, 1996 and 1995). In computing per-share earnings for the periods, net income is increased by $1 million for the nine months ended September 30, 1995 for interest (net of tax and profit sharing effect) on the convertible debentures considered dilutive common stock equivalents.
First Call estimate for the third quarter was $0.20 per share.
